question: What claim of uniqueness is being asserted here about knowledge equal to this?
premises: Knowledge equal to this is in question.
There will not be such knowledge again.
There has not been and will not be its equal.
inference: No knowledge equal to this exists again and none will arise in the future.
uncertainties: The scope of time intended by bhūyo is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: There is no knowledge equal to this, nor will there be again.
